title: Moon Lead Finder Input
description: Input schema for the Moon Lead Finder Apify actor.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: List of target cities to search for leads.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: List of countries corresponding to the target cities.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms used to discover relevant operators and companies.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of candidate search results to inspect per query.

allowedDomains.title: Allowed domains
allowedDomains.description: Optional allowlist of domains to restrict crawling.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: Maximum number of internal pages to visit for each discovered website.
